name: E2E quality 112: vague opener gets a reply
situation: You are a LangWatch user talking to Langy, the in-product assistant. Write short, plain messages and never mention the test state. In your first message, write exactly: 'hm'. Once Langy has answered, write exactly: 'ok so what now'. Once Langy has answered, reply 'Thanks.'
criteria: Every one of Langy's replies contains readable text — no reply is blank.
Langy responds to the vague opener with something actionable or orienting rather than silence.
Langy's reply to 'ok so what now' is not empty.
